summary: This week in AI, significant advancements were made in various fields, including AI watermarks, AI agent token costs, and AI-powered CRM. Companies like Anthropic, Okta, and Automattic are pushing the boundaries of AI technology. Meanwhile, concerns about AI safety and regulation continue to grow.
insight: The increasing use of AI watermarks and AI-powered tools is transforming the way we work and interact with technology, but it also raises important questions about accountability and transparency in AI development.
highlights: Anthropic's new watermarking system is catching users who try to use AI at work or in classes
Okta is reducing AI agent token costs with its identity-scoped Model Context Protocol tool
Automattic's AI-powered CRM, Mesh, is now available on Android
